headline: KOSPI tops 5,300 on AI optimism, market reform hopes
summary: South Korea's KOSPI set a record high on Wednesday, topping 5,300 points for the first time. Investors continued buying artificial intelligence-related stocks.
why: The KOSPI is the benchmark index of the Korea Exchange and includes large technology and industrial companies. Its moves reflect sentiment toward Korean equities and the semiconductor sector.

impacts.name: KOSPI
impacts.why: The index set a record high by topping 5,300 points, driven by AI-related buying.
